title: Etale algebras are Zariski-locally standard etale (Stacks 00UE)
statement: For a commutative ring $S$, a monic $f\in S[t]$ and $h\in S[t]$ such that $f'p_1+fp_2=h^n$ in $S[t]$ for some $p_1,p_2\in S[t]$ and $n\ge0$ (equivalently: $f'$ is invertible in $S[t]_h/(f)$), write $C(f,h)=S[t][Y]/(f,\,Yh-1)$ ($=S[t]_h/(f)$, the *standard etale algebra* of the pair $(f,h)$, Stacks Definition Tag 00UB) and $x\in C(f,h)$ for the class of $t$. Let $S\to B$ be a ring map such that $\operatorname{Spec}B\to\operatorname{Spec}S$ is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism], and let $\mathfrak q\subset B$ be a prime ideal. Then there exist $g\in B\setminus\mathfrak q$, a monic $f\in S[t]$, an $h\in S[t]$ with $f'p_1+fp_2=h^n$ for some $p_1,p_2\in S[t]$, $n\ge0$, and an isomorphism of $S$-algebras $B_g\cong C(f,h)$.
